# pull image from Dependency Proxy server instead of Docker Hub to prevent rate limit errors
ARG BASE_IMAGE_BUILDER=docker.io/python:3.13-slim
FROM ${BASE_IMAGE_BUILDER}

WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
CMD ["python", "display-server.py"]

LABEL com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable="false"
